currentArchitecture: fixed Rider Service Core projection and Brak danych fallback

targetTransitions.smallestPrimitive: A demand adapter that binds the existing catalogue/context contract to a research request.
A separate durable, provenance-bearing research-knowledge repository and read contract; do not use the garage row as a knowledge store.

targetTransitions.transition: known reusable knowledge -> user-visible safe fields
targetTransitions.smallestPrimitive: A projection adapter for profileless/partial research knowledge that retains status and never presents RED/YELLOW as verified Technical Profile data.
A demand-side deterministic GapPlan input adapter; existing GapPlan remains the semantic owner.
A durable demand identity/status index distinct from batch-scoped TargetWork and SourceWorkItem identities.
Cross-request status lookup with explicit terminal, human-review, blocked and unsupported states.
A non-production durable reusable-knowledge boundary; explicit production materialization remains separate.

targetTransitions.transition: new reusable knowledge -> refreshed profile view
targetTransitions.smallestPrimitive: A narrow reload/invalidation and projection seam; no mutation of committed profiles is implied.
A lookup keyed by canonical applicability and field identity, with immutable provenance lineage.

componentReuseMatrix.reason: Exact catalogue keys, explicit context states and fail-closed applicability already exist.
Deterministic batch execution, replay and bounded retry semantics remain useful after a demand adapter supplies work.
They need demand-to-target input, not a replacement planner or new field semantics.
Artifact custody, bounded requests and adapter validation already enforce the source boundary.
Raw values, provenance and human decision semantics remain required for on-demand work.
Existing explicit authorization boundary stays intact; a reusable research store must not be confused with production materialization.
Wave K and existing GREEN/YELLOW/RED contracts are historical and must not be changed.
Batch/pre-seeding remains a valid optional producer of demand inputs, not an on-demand replacement.
No current durable research-demand or reusable-knowledge store exists.
On-demand changes intake and reuse, not the bounded acquisition, extraction, review or authorization layers.

reusablePrimitives: deterministic Factory IDs, events, reducer and checkpoints
raw extraction, Review Queue, Human Review and Evidence Processing
Promotion Readiness and explicit production authorization
fixed Rider Service Core projection with Brak danych

identityAnalysis.recommendation: Use a separate reusable-demand key anchored by the existing catalogVariantKey/ResearchTarget identity plus canonical field identity and the exact applicable context. Do not use user ID, display strings or batch ID.
requiredDimensions: exact model year or explicit applicable range
source applicability/policy version when the demand is source-specific
identityAnalysis.sourceIdentityRule: Include source identity only for source-specific work; reusable knowledge must retain source identity and provenance but must not be keyed solely by a provider.
identityAnalysis.existingContractLimit: TargetWork identity includes batchId and targetId; SourceWorkItem additionally includes prospectId and operation. These are deterministic execution identities, not cross-user reusable-demand identities.

persistenceAnalysis.finding: No existing persistence model is sufficient. The current runtime database persists user-owned motorcycles/service records; committed Technical Profiles and their registry are production static data; materializer stores are explicit executor seams, not a reusable research database.
persistenceAnalysis.recommendation: Introduce, in a separately authorized future wave, a non-production durable research boundary for immutable reusable knowledge lineage and a demand/status index. Keep user garage rows, production Technical Profiles and production registry membership separate.
minimumRecords: canonical demand identity/status and links to Factory work/checkpoint
accepted reusable knowledge with field value, raw value, provenance, source identity, applicability and conditions
conflict/blocked/unsupported state without erasing prior safe knowledge
persistenceAnalysis.productionBoundary: Only the existing explicit promotion-review/authorization/materialization path may create or change production Technical Profile data.

partialProfiles.currentBehavior: A loaded production profile projects safe applicable Core cells and uses exactly Brak danych for missing cells; ambiguous applicability fails closed.
partialProfiles.targetBehavior: Add a separate research/reuse projection that can show safe known fields while a demand is running, awaiting review or unsupported. Preserve state labels and provenance; never turn ACCEPT into verified production evidence, and never display RED/YELLOW as verified data.
partialProfiles.unknownContext: Unknown market/ABS/equipment/transmission remains unresolved where required; no lookup or research request may broaden applicability.

duplicateDemand.complete: Return the immutable reusable result and project it.
duplicateDemand.inProgress: Join the existing demand/status record and its Factory work; do not create another acquisition.
duplicateDemand.awaitingHumanReview: Join the same work without retrying acquisition or creating a second candidate.
duplicateDemand.unsupportedOrBlocked: Reuse the explicit state for that field/context and continue unrelated fields or demands.
duplicateDemand.concurrencyRequirement: The future repository needs an atomic deterministic identity claim/upsert; current batch-local IDs cannot provide this across users.

profileRefresh: The narrow path is lookup/recompute of the research projection followed by the existing context-aware Core projection. Committed Technical Profile modules and registry membership remain unchanged until explicit production authorization; no broad profile merge is safe by default.

apiNinjasBoundary.contract: An explicitly declared adapter consumes an existing planned source work request and returns the existing bounded acquisition outcome/artifact contract.
apiNinjasBoundary.custody: The raw bounded response is an acquisition artifact with digest, byte length, media, locator and provider attribution; it is not evidence.
apiNinjasBoundary.secrets: API key is environment/secret configuration only and must never enter source code, reports, logs or artifact metadata.
apiNinjasBoundary.downstream: Existing extraction, provenance, applicability, Human Review, Evidence Processing and explicit promotion boundaries remain unchanged.
apiNinjasBoundary.reuseAndFailure: The future demand/status index prevents repeated equivalent requests; rate limits/provider failure become scoped transient/blocked outcomes and preserve existing safe knowledge.

failureIsolation.principle: One missing/RED/YELLOW field does not block unrelated safe fields; one source failure does not invalidate reusable knowledge; one motorcycle demand failure does not stop another demand.
failureIsolation.repositorySupport: Record-local Factory reducer/execution contracts and fixed Core projection support the principle within their current boundaries.
failureIsolation.missingSupport: Cross-request durable demand state, field-level lookup and a scheduler/refresh seam are still absent.

minimumImplementationPath.objective: Define deterministic demand/reuse contracts and pure lookup/projection over local fixtures.
minimumImplementationPath.boundary: Research/non-production contracts only; no schema, production or API adapter.
minimumImplementationPath.proof: Permutation-independent identity, exact applicability matching, partial safe projection and duplicate classification.

minimumImplementationPath.objective: Add the durable research demand/status and reusable-knowledge persistence boundary.
minimumImplementationPath.boundary: Non-production research data with ownership/access rules; immutable provenance and atomic dedup claim.
minimumImplementationPath.proof: Two equivalent requests share one demand; terminal/review/blocked states survive reload; unrelated fields remain usable.

minimumImplementationPath.objective: Bridge active motorcycle context to missing-field demand and run the existing Factory with deterministic/local fixtures.
minimumImplementationPath.boundary: Thin app/research adapter; existing Factory lifecycle remains authoritative.
minimumImplementationPath.proof: Known field projects immediately, one missing demand runs, accepted reusable result persists, profile projection refreshes, second equivalent request performs no acquisition.

minimumImplementationPath.objective: Separately authorize a provider adapter and production-promotion decision only after the local proof is stable.
minimumImplementationPath.boundary: Existing acquisition adapter and explicit production authorization boundaries.
minimumImplementationPath.proof: Provider failure/rate-limit isolation, attribution and no secret leakage; promotion remains explicit.

risks: A reusable accepted state could be mistaken for verified production evidence if the projection contract is not separate.
Applicability intersection and unknown dimensions can cause unsafe false reuse if identity normalization is permissive.
Concurrent demand claims require atomic persistence semantics not present in current tables.
Production Technical Profile refresh must not mutate committed registry/profile data implicitly.
assumptions: catalogVariantKey and existing context fields remain the canonical identity inputs.
The current 44-field Rider Service Core matrix remains closed.
A first architecture proof may use deterministic/local fixtures and does not require API Ninjas.
unknowns: Exact runtime tenancy and row-level access shape for shared reusable research knowledge.
Whether users may see human-accepted pre-evidence values, and the exact presentation status contract.
Conflict merge policy when two applicable sources produce different accepted candidates.
Provider terms, quotas and response schema for any future API Ninjas adapter.

historicalBoundaries.waveI: battery-capacity explicit-Ah scalar semantics remain valid and untouched
historicalBoundaries.waveG: hostile regression 3/2/4 remains historical and untouched

next: A separately authorized bounded implementation wave for deterministic research-demand and reusable-knowledge contracts, beginning with the local fixture proof; do not execute API Ninjas or production promotion in that wave.
